description: Human-reviewed quotation speaker and pronoun resolution accuracy for the v2 narrative-multitask model on 11 public-domain Gutenberg novel excerpts outside LitBank and PDNC (one excerpt, a critical essay rather than fiction, was excluded). 9 titles share an author with LitBank/PDNC training data; 2 do not.

excerpts.title: The Garden Party, and Other Stories

review.method: scripts/review_sheet.py sheet generated a CSV of every model-predicted quotation speaker and pronoun antecedent in context; rows were graded for correctness by an OpenAI gpt-6.1-sol Batch API job given the full excerpt as context, with a sample manually graded and spot-checked by the project owner
review.excludedExcerpt: 416 (Winesburg, Ohio excerpt is a critical essay about the book, not Anderson's fiction)
